Why Daily Huddle Boards Help Hospital Nurses

  • Improve patient safety: Surface risks, changing patient needs, and concerns early so the team can respond proactively.
  • Strengthen communication: Give nurses and interdisciplinary team members a consistent place to share priorities and clarify issues at the start of a shift.
  • Create visibility and accountability: A visual board keeps current issues, safety performance, and items needing escalation visible to the frontline team.
